tools.name: acp_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an active ACP credential

tools.name: nhi_inventory
tools.description: List all non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, certificates)

tools.name: nhi_orphans

tools.name: ert_scan
tools.description: Run ERT security scan (SBOM, CVE, secrets, STIG, PQC inventory) in Docker sandbox

tools.name: ert_readiness
tools.description: Package A: NIST 800-171 Rev2 compliance assessment + live SCA risk factor. Returns alignment score (0-100), control gaps, and prioritized remediation roadmap.

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: ert_architect
tools.description: Package B: Live supply chain risk — Syft SBOM + Grype CVE + CISA KEV/EPSS/MITRE enrichment. Returns findings with NIST 800-171 control mapping.

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: ert_crypto
tools.description: Package C: PQC readiness attestation — source-level crypto primitive scan, SBOM crypto library inventory, weak primitive detection (MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4), CNSA 2.0 quantum risk context.

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: ert_godfather
tools.description: Package D: EA KernelRouter causal risk attestation. Runs STIG, PQC, SBOM, Network agents in parallel, produces board-level causal chain with CVSS-band dollar impact and DAG-signed evidence node.

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: stig_check
tools.description: Check a system path or configuration against STIG controls. Default: RHEL-09-STIG-V1R3. Returns CAT I/II/III findings with remediation guidance and compliance score.

tools.name: pqc_stig
tools.description: World's First DoD PQC STIG (PQC-01-STIG-V1R1). CNSA 2.0 / FIPS 203/204/205 compliance assessment. Returns per-control findings, compliance score, and ML-DSA-65 signed evidence.

tools.name: cmmc_assess
tools.description: CMMC Level 1/2/3 assessment via KHEPRA compliance database (36,195 STIG→CCI→NIST→CMMC mappings). Returns satisfaction score, gaps, C3PAO readiness flag, and PQC status.

tools.name: nist_map
tools.description: Offline semantic search across NIST 800-53 Rev5, NIST 800-171 Rev2, CMMC 2.0, and STIG CCI mappings. BM25 ranked results. Zero token cost, air-gap safe. 36,000+ controls indexed.

framework.description: Filter by framework: NIST-800-53, NIST-800-171, CMMC-L2, STIG (default: all)

tools.name: dag_attestation
tools.description: Export the PQC-signed DAG audit trail for the current session. Returns all DAG nodes with ML-DSA-65 signatures, timestamps, and Adinkra symbol chain.

tools.name: godfather_report
tools.description: Generate an executive compliance report covering CMMC/STIG/NIST frameworks. When approval_required=true, returns a staged token — the full report is held until a human calls godfather_approve (30-min TTL).

approval_required.description: Stage report for human review before delivery (default: false)

framework.description: Compliance framework: CMMC-L2, NIST-800-171, NIST-800-53 (default: CMMC-L2)

scope.description: Control family scope: all, AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI (default: all)

tools.name: godfather_approve
tools.description: Deliver a staged executive compliance report. Requires the staged_token returned by godfather_report. Single-use — token is consumed on delivery.

staged_token.description: Token returned by godfather_report when approval_required=true

tools.name: khepra_export_attestation
tools.description: Export PQC-signed attestation package covering all active compliance frameworks. C3PAO-ready evidence artifact — ML-DSA-65 signed, DAG-anchored.

project_path.description: Path to project root (default: current directory)

tools.name: khepra_export_poam
tools.description: Export a DFARS 252.204-7012 POA&M (Plan of Action & Milestones) from the current DAG state. Maps open findings to remediation timelines.

tools.name: khepra_query_stig
tools.description: Query the embedded STIG/CCI/NIST control database (36,195 mappings). Look up STIG rules, CCI items, NIST 800-53 controls by ID or keyword.

framework.description: Filter by framework: STIG, CCI, NIST-800-53, CMMC

tools.name: khepra_get_compliance_score
tools.description: Fast compliance score without full scan. Returns current CMMC/NIST/STIG satisfaction percentages from cached DAG state.

tools.name: khepra_query_threat_intel
tools.description: Query embedded CISA KEV + CVE threat intelligence from offline database. Returns relevant CVEs, EPSS scores, MITRE ATT&CK mappings.

kev_only.description: Filter to CISA KEV only (default: false)

pqc_impact.description: Include CNSA 2.0 quantum impact assessment (default: false)

query.description: Search term (CVE ID, product name, or keyword)

tools.name: khepra_get_dag_chain
tools.description: Export the PQC-signed DAG chain for the current session. Returns all DAG nodes with ML-DSA-65 signatures and Adinkra symbol provenance.

tools.name: khepra_watch
tools.description: Register a filesystem path for continuous STIG-triggered scanning. Fires ert_scan on file changes.

tools.name: discover_assets
tools.description: Inventory environment: OS, runtimes, containers, CI/CD, AI agents, crypto libs, MCP configs. Recommends CMMC level and applicable STIG profiles.

tools.name: agent_record
tools.description: Record an agent action in the SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder. Records to PQC-signed DAG audit log.

tools.name: flight_export
tools.description: Export a CMMC-aligned evidence packet from the SouHimBou AI flight log. Maps agent actions to NIST 800-171 / CMMC 2.0 controls.

tools.name: owasp_agent_assess
tools.description: Assess this MCP server deployment against OWASP Agentic Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10). Returns scored findings, active controls, gaps, and ML-DSA-65 signed evidence.

tools.name: dark_crypto_contribute
tools.description: Privacy-preserving contribution of anonymized cryptographic inventory to the Global Quantum Exposure Network. Returns aggregate quantum risk ranking.

tools.name: sbom_generate
tools.description: Generate a CycloneDX / SPDX SBOM with PQC readiness annotations.

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: threat_model
tools.description: Generate a STRIDE threat model with NIST 800-53 + MITRE ATT&CK mappings. 100% offline.

framework.description: Threat framework: STRIDE | PASTA | LINDDUN (default: STRIDE)

project_path.description: Path to project directory (default: current directory)

tools.name: kasa_start
tools.description: Start the KASA autonomous security agent. Launches: vulnerability hunting hourly, internal pentest daily (NIST 800-53 CA-8), CMMC compliance audit daily. Every action is DAG-attested.

tools.name: kasa_status
tools.description: Check current status of the KASA autonomous agent: uptime, active tasks, threat score, and EA kernel generation.

tools.name: kasa_task
tools.description: Inject a security directive into the KASA task queue, bound to an Adinkra symbol (Eban=defense, Sankofa=forensics, OwoForoAdobe=vigilance, Dwennimmen=remediation). Executed within KASA's next cognitive cycle (≤5s).

description.description: Task directive for KASA to execute

tools.name: kasa_scan
tools.description: Run KASA's port/service scanner against a target, with AI threat analysis. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1046. Every finding is DAG-attested with ML-DSA-65.

tools.name: kasa_forensics
tools.description: Trigger an immediate KASA forensic snapshot — processes, network connections, open ports, file hashes — compared against the last snapshot for anomaly detection. DAG-attested under symbol Sankofa.

tools.name: kasa_crypto_agent
tools.description: Run the KASA Crypto Agent: detects tampering via entropy/structural feature analysis, computes a threat level, and auto-quarantines components above the Critical threshold with PQC-sealed forensic snapshots.

component_id.description: Component identifier to check for tampering (default: PQC-Khepra-MCP)

tools.name: ea_evolve
tools.description: Run Evolutionary Algorithm threat evolution. Optimizes for: NIST 800-171 control coverage, PQC readiness, threat posture. Returns the fittest genome with Adinkra symbol binding.

target.description: Target to evolve against (default: current directory)

tools.name: ea_threat_score
tools.description: Calculate a composite threat score for a target using the EA kernel. Returns CVSS-band score, confidence interval, and contributing factors.

tools.name: ea_risk_summary
tools.description: Synthesize EA-driven risk summary: vulnerability exposure, compliance gap, PQC migration cost, blast radius. Same engine as Godfather Report.

tools.name: quantum_optimize
tools.description: Run Ising model quantum-inspired optimization for attack surface analysis. Simulates quantum annealing to find optimal defense configuration.

target.description: Target system to optimize (default: current directory)

tools.name: threat_lookup
tools.description: Look up a CVE, IP, or domain against embedded CISA KEV + MITRE ATT&CK databases. Returns CVE details, CVSS/EPSS scores, ATT&CK TTP mapping.

query.description: CVE ID, IP address, domain, or keyword to look up

tools.name: drift_detect
tools.description: Detect configuration drift between current state and a signed baseline. Uses the KHEPRA DriftEngine with Adinkra symbol binding.

tools.name: ir_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident in the KHEPRA IR Manager. Every incident is ML-DSA-65 signed at creation and DAG-attested.

tools.name: ir_add_ioc
tools.description: Add an Indicator of Compromise to an existing incident. The IOC is ML-DSA-65 signed and DAG-recorded.

incident_id.description: Incident ID to attach IOC to

ioc_type.description: IOC type: ip | domain | hash | url | email

tools.name: flight_record
tools.description: Record an agent tool call to the SouHimBou AI Flight Recorder with cryptographic attestation. Creates a cryptographically verifiable audit trail.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called

tools.name: ouroboros_waf_eye
tools.description: Ouroboros WAF Eye — real-time web application firewall status from the Mitochondrial API Server. Returns blocked requests, threat patterns, and active rules.

tools.name: ouroboros_stig_eye
tools.description: Ouroboros STIG Eye — continuous STIG compliance monitoring status. Returns current compliance posture and drift alerts.

tools.name: ouroboros_vuln_eye
tools.description: Ouroboros Vuln Eye — continuous vulnerability scanning status. Returns active CVEs, EPSS scores, and remediation priority.

tools.name: ouroboros_fim_eye
tools.description: Ouroboros FIM Eye — file integrity monitoring status. Returns hash baseline comparison and drift alerts.

tools.name: forensic_snapshot
tools.description: Collect a DFIR-grade forensic snapshot: processes, network connections, loaded modules, environment variables. ML-DSA-65 signed, DAG-attested.

tools.name: fim_baseline
tools.description: Create a file integrity monitoring baseline. Monitors critical paths using SHA-256 hash baselines. Baseline is DAG-attested.

tools.name: audit_dag_integrity
tools.description: Full integrity audit of the KASA DAG. Verifies: node count, parent linkage, PQC metadata completeness, and signature chain.

tools.name: enumerate_host
tools.description: Enumerate host information: OS, kernel, network interfaces, running services, users, installed packages. MITRE ATT&CK T1082.

tools.name: fingerprint_device
tools.description: Fingerprint a network device: OS detection, service banners, protocol analysis. MITRE ATT&CK T1046.

tools.name: port_scan
tools.description: TCP port scan with service banner grabbing. Identifies open ports and running services. MITRE ATT&CK T1046.

tools.name: vuln_scan
tools.description: Scan project for known vulnerabilities in dependencies (Go, NPM, Python). Returns CVE IDs, CVSS scores, affected packages, and fix versions.

tools.name: secret_scan
tools.description: Scan for hardcoded secrets using entropy analysis + pattern matching. Detects: AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, JWT secrets, database passwords.

tools.name: container_scan
tools.description: Analyze Dockerfile and container manifests for security misconfigurations and base image vulnerabilities.

tools.name: compliance_scan
tools.description: Run built-in compliance checks against CIS, STIG, and NIST baselines. Returns pass/fail per control with remediation guidance.

framework.description: Framework: CIS | STIG | NIST | ALL (default: ALL)

tools.name: packet_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a PCAP capture file. Extracts: protocol distribution, suspicious connections, DNS queries, HTTP methods, potential C2 patterns.

tools.name: attack_graph
tools.description: Generate an attack graph from current NHI inventory. Models lateral movement paths, privilege escalation vectors, and blast radius.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign arbitrary data with ML-DSA-65. Returns base64-encoded signature and public key ID. Air-gap safe.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Verify an ML-DSA-65 signature against data. Returns verification result and signer metadata.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate a new ML-DSA-65 keypair for agent identity. Returns public key (base64) and key ID. Private key is stored securely.

tools.name: dag_write
tools.description: Write a manually-specified attested node to the shared KASA DAG. Use for arbitrary compliance events, human approvals, and audit points.

action.description: Action name for the DAG node

tools.name: dag_query
tools.description: Query the KASA DAG for nodes matching criteria. Returns matched nodes with signatures and provenance.

tools.name: dag_audit
tools.description: Perform a full integrity audit of the KASA DAG. Verifies node count, parent linkage, PQC metadata completeness.

tools.name: phantom_stealth
tools.description: Engage network security posture hardening mode. Reduces attack surface exposure through traffic obfuscation and endpoint protection.

tools.name: identity_shroud
tools.description: Encode a credential or token using post-quantum obfuscation for secure transport.

tools.name: identity_epiphany
tools.description: Decode a PQC-obfuscated credential back to its original form.

tools.name: drbc_backup
tools.description: Create a DRBC genesis backup of the KHEPRA project. AES-256-GCM encrypted, ML-DSA-65 signed.

tools.name: drbc_restore
tools.description: Restore the KHEPRA project from a DRBC genesis backup. Requires the same password used during backup.

tools.name: playbook_execute
tools.description: Execute a SouHimBou SOAR playbook from the agent channel. Defaults to staging environment unless 'production' is explicitly specified.

environment.description: Execution environment: 'staging' (default) or 'production'. Production requires explicit opt-in.

playbook_name.description: Name of the built-in or disk-loaded SOAR playbook (e.g. 'quarantine-agent', 'rate-limit-agent', 'evidence-capture')

tools.name: asaf_lint
tools.description: Lint an ASAF Policy Declaration Language (APDL) snippet. Validates @symbol, @framework, control block, and maps: clause presence.

policy_snippet.description: The ASAF APDL policy string to lint (must include @symbol, @framework, control block, and maps: clause)

tools.name: compliance_model_check
tools.description: Verify if an LLM model is approved for the current KHEPRA deployment tier. Enforces sovereign (no commercial LLMs), hybrid, and edge tier policies from AGENTS.md.

tier.description: Deployment tier to check against: 'sovereign', 'hybrid', or 'edge' (default: 'hybrid')
